limitations: No physical scale calibration is documented.
Camera pose is not vehicle-body pose without a camera-to-body transform.
Edit intervals are fit independently; no derivative crosses an edit boundary.
Derivative and discontinuity signals are retrospective reconstruction diagnostics.

methods.bspline: independent cubic smoothing spline per coordinate

factor_graph.reason: optional dependency not required for first CPU slice

normalization.position_origin: first raw camera center in each edit segment
normalization.position_scale: raw camera-path arc length per edit segment
normalization.time_origin: first timestamp in each edit segment
normalization.time_scale: per-segment duration for fitting; concatenated sequence for UI

orientation_policy: raw_camera_orientation retained for every translation layer
